All-in-one upload guide

Getting your export onto Steam

Cropping is only half the job - Steam doesn't have a normal upload button for these showcase types, so here's exactly how to get each one live, with copy-paste steps for every case.

Why the console command? Artwork, Screenshot, and Workshop Showcase images all go through Steam's Guide image editor, which normally expects a guide's cover image - not a showcase piece. The one-line command below just tells that editor which showcase type and dimensions you actually mean before you save, which is the same trick the wider Steam customization community has used for years.
Artwork Showcase Screenshot Showcase Workshop Showcase Guide Showcase

Artwork Showcase

The wide/thin image pair this Cropper's Artwork tab produces.

1

Open steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/edititem/767/3/

2

Select your artwork image.

3

Right-click anywhere on the page → Inspect → open the Console tab.

4

Paste this and press Enter:

$J('#image_width').val(1000),$J('#image_height').val(1);
5

Click Save and Continue.

Screenshot Showcase

Same flow as Artwork Showcase, with one extra field set.

1

Open steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/edititem/767/3/

2

Select your artwork image.

3

Right-click anywhere on the page → Inspect → open the Console tab.

4

Paste this and press Enter:

$J('#image_width').val(1000),$J('#image_height').val(1),$J('[name=file_type]').val(5);
5

Click Save and Continue.

Workshop Showcase

The 5-slice strip this Cropper's Workshop tab produces.

1

Open steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/edititem/767/3/

2

Select your artwork image.

3

Right-click anywhere on the page → Inspect → open the Console tab.

4

Paste this and press Enter:

$J('[name=consumer_app_id]').val(480),$J('[name=file_type]').val(0),$J('[name=visibility]').val(0);
5

Click Save and Continue.

Guide Showcase

Not something this Cropper exports, but the same trick applies - included for the full picture.

1

Open the editor for the icon style you want:

Steam Icon → Transparent Icon →
2

Select your artwork image.

3

Click Save and Continue - no console step needed for either icon style.

Long Guide

For a tall Guide Showcase image instead of a small icon.

1

Open steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/edititem/767/3/

2

Select your artwork image.

3

Right-click anywhere on the page → Inspect → open the Console tab.

4

Paste this and press Enter:

$J('[name=consumer_app_id]').val(753);$J('#image_width').val('1000');$J('#image_height').val('1');$J('[name=file_type]').val('9');
5

Click Save and Continue.
